sentences.en: Look at the cute little baby sleeping in the cradle.
sentences.zh: 1. 看看摇篮里睡着的那个可爱的小宝宝。

sentences.en: Never have I seen such a cute puppy as this.
sentences.zh: 2. 我从未见过如此可爱的狗狗。

sentences.en: He's really cute, and so I like working with him.
sentences.zh: 3. 他真的很讨人喜欢，所以我乐意和他一起工作。

senses.zh: 可爱的；漂亮的；讨人喜欢的
